page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing dedicated CPU allocation. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.sn2.large in the lower performance tiers. CPU performance tests, including stress-ng single-core and multi-core suites, place the instance in the bottom 25%. Similarly, memory bandwidth benchmarks show weak to poor performance, with uncached large-block read operations falling into the bottom 10% at 21.24 GB/sec. Computational tasks such as gzip compression, bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests consistently register in the bottom 10% to 25% categories.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the ecs.sn2.large is suited for low-intensity general-purpose workloads. These include basic web serving, lightweight database operations, and simple background tasks that do not require high-throughput memory or intensive CPU calculations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio on dedicated hardware, making it a predictable option for legacy applications or development environments where high performance is not a primary requirement.
